top_signals.title: Old Mutual Wants South Africa’s Newest Bank Profitable by 2028
top_signals.summary: Profit at Old Mutual declined for the first time since 2022 as risk-off sentiment from conflicts in the Middle East curbed investment returns at the Africa’s biggest insurer by assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Washington’s Venezuela Oil Deal Is About Much More Than Crude
top_signals.summary: Washington’s takeover of more than a fifth of Venezuela’s oil reserves in a deal officially signed by U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright on 2 September was as unexpected as it was dramatic, with President Donald Trump’s comment a few days earlier that it is “the biggest oil deal in world history” looking justified from several perspectives.
